headline_findings: CLOSED_35 reduces to 13 atomic reusable physical edge classes plus one compound-interaction court; source snapshots compose these classes many-to-many rather than requiring 35 adapters.

Candidate-local reader, traversal, streaming, cache, sparse-representation and materialization choices are allowed only when exact physical incidence, replay identity and governed semantic/output identity remain invariant.
Compatibility decoding is physical execution configuration only. It never supplies source-text semantic authority.
EVS 1999 and EVS 2008 require malformed-declared-text quarantine: their latin1 compatibility path cannot silently become intended-label authority.

The current generic physical decoder/facade architecture already represents SAV/DTA, compatibility mode, typed missingness, row replay, dictionaries/display metadata, MR metadata, explicit topology/routing/coordinate/weight authority boundaries.

Latinobarometro 2024 exposes the one proved generic physical-carrier gap: the accepted nominal_case_size=174 versus 332-variable dictionary/data-stream witness is not exposed by the current PhysicalSourceIncidence.file_metadata surface. The lawful repair is generic raw-header/layout preservation, not a source-specific semantic adapter.

Authority71/72 packet readiness is not source certification or current runtime realization. LiTS-I and WVS7 remain the only current source-specific realizations proved at the FIABC-A04 evidence boundary.
EC14 is a composition meta-class, not another adapter interface: compound sources must pass all applicable EC01-EC13 invariants simultaneously.
